method: Two sessions of 100 measured fresh processes per runtime and cache mode, rotating order. One warmup excluded per engine/session. Warm mode uses separate explicit cache directories per engine, primed by the warmup. Cold mode gives every process a fresh empty directory. Node/Lumen use NODE_COMPILE_CACHE; Bun uses BUN_RUNTIME_TRANSPILER_CACHE_PATH. Additional bunDefault rows retain Bun default caching to preserve comparison with the older harness. All samples retained; exact output hashes and cache state asserted.
limitations: One locked Vite 6.4.6 fixture on one shared Linux x86-64 host; not a claim about all JavaScript workloads or platforms.
Filesystem caches remain warm. Explicit runtime caches are primed or reset as labeled. Bun default-cache runs are an additional reference, not empty-cache results.
The optional allocator increases resident memory and responds to Linux transparent huge-page availability; a separate settings diagnostic showed host/session variation.
The default CLI baseline contains the same engine changes as the profiled build; it is not the previous main-branch release.
Intervals are exploratory stratified bootstraps across two sessions, following substantial experimentation. All measured samples are retained.

paired.method: Exploratory within-round ratios, with 10,000 bootstrap resamples stratified by the two 100-round sessions. Median paired ratio and percentile interval. Shared-host variability and repeated experimentation limit generalization; these are not preregistered trials.

annotatedMemcheck.tracking: MI_TRACK_VALGRIND=1 with verified byte-precise mimalloc annotations; separate target, same compiler PGO profile

memory.method: GNU time maximum resident set size (KiB), eight fresh-process builds per binary and cache mode with alternating order and one excluded warmup. Runtime and descendant resource accounting, not summed simultaneous RSS. Identical output hashes required.

retainedFunctions.method: Twelve batches of 20,000 independently compiled functions, retaining every hundredth function across explicit collections. Eight fresh-process measurements per binary, rotating order and one excluded warmup. GNU time peak RSS, whole-process wall time, fixed checksum and live references verified.

fib.method: Two sessions of 30 fresh processes per binary, within-round candidate/baseline ratios; exploratory stratified bootstrap. Named self-recursive FIB is interpreted, not a JIT throughput measurement.

sessions.name: fib-validation
sessions.method: Thirty fresh-process recursive Fibonacci runs per binary plus one excluded warmup, alternating the current candidate and normal std-only baseline. Node stdout oracle, whole-process timing, PGO candidate versus normal std-only baseline; named self-recursion remains interpreted.
